frames.data:
an sync

Pull the trunk branch from remote and delete any branches that have been merged.
If trunk cannot be fast-forwarded to match remote, overwrites trunk with the
remote version. Sync does not refresh feature heads; use get for feature
updates.

Options:
      --help                  Show help                                [boolean]
      --version               Show version number                      [boolean]
      --cwd                   Working directory. Use a direct --cwd prefix
                              before the Git command for passthroughs; before or
                              after the command for Anthracite commands.[string]
      --interactive           Enable interactive features. Defaults to terminal
                              input and output. Disable with --no-interactive;
                              quiet also disables interaction.         [boolean]
  -q, --quiet                 Minimize output to the terminal.

[boolean] [default: false]
      --verify                Run git hooks. Disable with --no-verify.
                                                       [boolean] [default: true]
      --debug                 Display debug output.   [boolean] [default: false]
  -p, --pull                  Pull the trunk branch from remote.
                                                       [boolean] [default: true]
  -d, --delete                Delete branches which have been merged.
                                                       [boolean] [default: true]
      --show-delete-progress  Show progress through merged branches.
                                                      [boolean] [default: false]
  -f, --force                 Don't prompt for confirmation before deleting a
                              branch or resetting trunk to remote.
                                                      [boolean] [default: false]
  -r, --restack               Restack the current stack and any stacks
